questions.text: What does Amir do during his twelve-minute walk to university every morning?
opts: He listens to an English podcast.
He plans his day in a notebook.
questions.correct: He listens to an English podcast.
questions.hint: "The walk takes about twelve minutes, which he uses to listen to an English podcast."

questions.text: Amir misses lectures when he has a lot of assignments to complete.
questions.hint: "He never misses a class unless he is seriously ill."

questions.text: According to the text, why does Amir sit at the same desk near the window in the library?
opts: It is away from noisy areas.
questions.correct: It is away from noisy areas.
questions.hint: "He sits at the same desk near the window, away from the noisy areas."

questions.text: Amir believes that three focused hours of work are worth more than ___ distracted hours.
questions.hint: "Three hours of focused work is worth more than six hours of distracted work."

questions.text: What is Amir's main message about building good habits?
opts: You need talent to succeed at university.
You should study as many hours as possible.
Small, consistent habits are more powerful than occasional bursts of effort.
Rest is a waste of time for serious students.
questions.correct: Small, consistent habits are more powerful than occasional bursts of effort.
questions.hint: "Consistency. Small habits, every single day. You don't need to be the most talented..."

questions.text: How many times a week does Amir check his messages?
questions.hint: "He checks messages twice a day — once at lunchtime and once in the evening."

questions.text: Why does Kamila sometimes feel dizzy at 10 a.m.?
opts: She studies too hard without a break.
She hasn't eaten anything — she skips breakfast.
She runs before class and gets tired.
questions.correct: She hasn't eaten anything — she skips breakfast.
questions.hint: "I sometimes feel dizzy by 10 a.m. because I haven't eaten anything."

questions.text: Zhibek exercises in the mornings before class.
questions.hint: "I go to the campus gym twice a week after classes. Morning exercise doesn't work for me."

questions.text: Amir sits in the ___ row during lectures to help him stay focused.
questions.hint: "I always sit in the front row. If the professor can see me, I stay focused."

questions.text: What method does Zhibek use to stay focused during long lectures?
opts: She sits in the front row.
She records the lecture on her phone.
questions.hint: "I take notes by hand. Writing things down keeps my brain active."

questions.text: Amir's rule about his phone is that he never checks social media until:
opts: After all lectures are done for the day.
After he has had coffee and reviewed his notes.
On his way to the library.
questions.correct: After he has had coffee and reviewed his notes.
questions.hint: "I never check my phone before I've had coffee and reviewed my notes. That's my rule."

questions.text: Kamila goes running every day of the week before her lectures.
questions.hint: "I go for a run three times a week — usually Monday, Wednesday, and Friday."

questions.text: She ___ (study) in the library every Tuesday and Thursday evening.
questions.hint: She = 3rd person singular. study ends in consonant + y → studies (drop y, add -ies).

questions.text: Which sentence has the CORRECT word order with a frequency adverb?
opts: He goes always to the library.
He always goes to the library.
Always he goes to the library.
He goes to always the library.
questions.correct: He always goes to the library.
questions.hint: Adverb of frequency goes BEFORE the main verb: "He always goes..." ✅

questions.text: Kamila ___ (not eat) breakfast — she just grabs a coffee and runs.
questions.hint: 3rd person singular negative: doesn't + base verb. Never 'don't eats' or 'doesn't eats'.

questions.text: "___ Amir review his notes every day?" — "Yes, he ___."
questions.hint: Amir = he → Does he review...? Short answer: Yes, he does. (3rd person singular)

questions.text: "She ___ misses class — it has happened only once in two years." Which adverb fits?
questions.hint: "rarely" ≈ 10%. Only once in two years = almost never, which = rarely.

questions.text: "She speaks English ___." Choose the correct form.
questions.hint: good → well (irregular adverb of manner). Describes HOW she speaks: "She speaks English well." ✅

questions.text: "He studies hardly every night" means he works very hard every night.
questions.hint: "hardly" = almost not / barely. "He hardly studies" = he barely studies. For effort: "He studies hard." ✅

questions.text: "She completed the exam ___." Which adverb correctly describes how she did it?
questions.hint: "fastly" and "goodly" don't exist. "quick" is an adjective. "carefully" = adverb of manner from "careful". ✅

questions.text: "Having a consistent routine helps you avoid stress." What does "consistent" mean?
questions.hint: "consistent" = always behaving or performing in the same way. A consistent routine = a stable, unchanging routine.

questions.text: He turns off all phone ___ during study sessions so he isn't distracted.
questions.hint: "notifications" = alerts from a phone or computer. "He turns off all social media notifications."

questions.text: "She manages her time ___." Which word best completes the sentence?
questions.hint: "efficiently" = adverb of manner. Describes HOW she manages her time. adjective = efficient, adverb = efficiently.

questions.text: "The deadline is tomorrow — I need to submit my assignment before midnight." What is a "deadline"?
opts: the latest time to finish something
a list of tasks to complete
questions.correct: the latest time to finish something
questions.hint: "deadline" = the latest time by which you must finish something. Miss the deadline = you are too late!

questions.text: Which sentence uses the word "priority" correctly?
opts: Sleep is a priority — it affects concentration.
I priority to study every day.
She is very priority in her work.
questions.correct: Sleep is a priority — it affects concentration.
questions.hint: "priority" is a noun — "make something a priority", "be a priority". "Sleep is a priority." ✅
